serviceName: K8 HQ: move incoming mail to K8 HQ. Approve only if you are setting up K8 HQ yourself right now.
description: Points the domain's incoming mail (MX) at the organization's K8 HQ mail host. This replaces the domain's current MX records, so mail stops going to the old provider.
variableDescription: %mxlabel%: the organization's K8 HQ mail host label (the <label> in <label>.mx.k8hq.net); the rest of the MX target is fixed, so the template can only point mail at K8 HQ
